name: @liuyu-f/dsh-plugin-session-cascade-delete
description: Permanently delete DeepSeek Harness sessions from the UI (header button + sidebar row menu) or via the session_delete tool: removes the log directory, projection cache and workspace accounting, cascades into the subagent sessions a session owns (your forked branches are never touched), and stops a running agent first.

contributors.name: lsz-asd
contributors.note: original @huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete this plugin is adapted from

meta.title: Cascade Session Delete
meta.description: Permanently delete a session from the header button or the sidebar row menu, cascading into the subagent sessions it owns.
